hero.intro_en: Practice 3 real situations where you need to stay ethical and professional: a secret about layoffs, a report to HR, and an expensive gift from a client. Practice out loud, see what you said, and repeat until it sounds natural.

original.goal: Practice handling workplace ethical dilemmas clearly, respectfully and professionally through three roleplays.
original.goal_es: Practicar cómo manejar dilemas éticos en el trabajo de forma clara, respetuosa y profesional con tres juegos de roles.
original.title: Roleplay: Handling Ethical Dilemmas
original.title_es: Juego de Roles: Manejo de Dilemas Éticos
original.body_en:
🤝 Speaking Practice

Title: Roleplay: Handling Ethical Dilemmas
Time: 2 hours

Remember that if you don't have a partner to practice with, use ChatGPT.

Activity 1 – Confidential Information
Partner plays a coworker: "I'll tell you something I heard about layoffs, but don't tell anyone."
You respond professionally.

Activity 2 – Reporting Misconduct
Partner plays HR. You explain that you saw a coworker misusing company resources. Practice being clear, respectful, and objective.

Activity 3 – Gray Area Decision
Partner plays a client offering you an expensive gift. You respond: "Thank you, but I need to check our company's policy first."

Reflection:
Which roleplay was most difficult for you? What strategy helped you stay professional?
original.body_es:
🤝 Práctica de Hablar

Título: Juego de Roles: Manejo de Dilemas Éticos
Tiempo: 2 horas

Recuerda que si no tienes un compañero para practicar, usa ChatGPT.

Actividad 1 – Información Confidencial
El compañero juega como un colega: "I'll tell you something I heard about layoffs, but don't tell anyone." 
Responde de manera profesional.

Actividad 2 – Reportar Mala Conducta
El compañero juega como Recursos Humanos. Explicas que viste a un colega haciendo un mal uso de los recursos de la empresa. Practica ser claro, respetuoso y objetivo.

Actividad 3 – Decisión en Área Gris
El compañero juega como un cliente que te ofrece un regalo caro. Respondes: "Thank you, but I need to check our company's policy first."

Reflexión:
¿Cuál juego de roles fue el más difícil para ti? ¿Qué estrategia te ayudó a mantenerte profesional?

how.en: Practice 3 times. Each time, find a kind but firm way to stop the gossip.
how.es: Practica 3 veces. En cada una, busca una forma amable pero firme de detener el chisme.

scene.line: I'll tell you something I heard about layoffs, but don't tell anyone.

en: Say you'd rather not hear or share rumors
es: Di que prefieres no escuchar ni compartir rumores

situation.en: A coworker says: “I'll tell you something I heard about layoffs, but don't tell anyone.” You respond professionally.
situation.es: Un colega te dice: “I'll tell you something I heard about layoffs, but don't tell anyone.” Respondes de manera profesional.

how.en: Practice 3 times: once alone, once with a partner or ChatGPT playing HR, and once more with your best version. Be clear, respectful and objective.
how.es: Practica 3 veces: una sola, una con un compañero o ChatGPT haciendo de Recursos Humanos, y otra con tu mejor versión. Sé claro, respetuoso y objetivo.

scene.line: Thanks for reaching out. What would you like to tell me?

en: What you saw: the facts (what, when, where)
No labels or guesses about the person
Offer to give more details or help
es: Lo que viste: los hechos (qué, cuándo, dónde)
Sin etiquetas ni suposiciones sobre la persona
Ofrece dar más detalles o ayudar

en: Try 2: with a partner or ChatGPT
es: Intento 2: con un compañero o ChatGPT

situation.en: Your partner plays HR. You explain that you saw a coworker misusing company resources (for example, using the company card for personal purchases). Practice being clear, respectful and objective.
situation.es: Tu compañero hace de Recursos Humanos. Explicas que viste a un colega haciendo mal uso de los recursos de la empresa (por ejemplo, usar la tarjeta de la empresa para compras personales). Practica ser claro, respetuoso y objetivo.

how.en: Practice 3 times. Always include the key sentence: “Thank you, but I need to check our company's policy first.”
how.es: Practica 3 veces. Incluye siempre la frase clave: “Thank you, but I need to check our company's policy first.”

scene.line: We got you something special to say thank you: a new tablet!

en: Say: “Thank you, but I need to check our company's policy first.”
es: Di: “Thank you, but I need to check our company's policy first.”

situation.en: Your partner plays a client offering you an expensive gift. You respond: “Thank you, but I need to check our company's policy first.”
situation.es: Tu compañero hace de cliente y te ofrece un regalo caro. Respondes: “Thank you, but I need to check our company's policy first.”
